title: Return the Rescued
description: Fenna has said nothing the whole walk back. Take her to Millbrook's priest and let him decide what her father is told.

objectives.description: Bring Fenna to the priest in Millbrook

notes: Closing beat: the rescue costs the priest a truth he still has not told her father, and costs the player the certainty that saving her fixed anything. No mechanical consequence is wired - whether Fenna stays in Millbrook or leaves again is prose only, a second path this pass could not build.
